regression_metric.clarification: Post-hoc clarification of doc119 catch, explicitly requested before this fresh-seed confirmation. Earlier identification results not relabelled.
regression_metric.gated: nonpromotion by ANY route, including primary nonacceptance, G1, G2, risk followup and cap insufficient_power

risk_followup.allocation: Every primary acceptance, irrespective of observed losses/G2 outcome; 40 fresh items within total500. Immediate G1/domain failures terminate.
risk_followup.decision: Nonnegative fresh net passes; negative net rejects. Safety-risk structural ties are judged by G1 alone, no discordance minimum; no pooling risk40 into G2/e-process.

scope: Fresh simulated scores; no model calls; signature payload conditional on qualification, no activation. Risk-stratum fixture matches v5 and does not establish power for arbitrary risk strata.
